import inspect

import solution
from solution import parabola_directrix


def test_issue_example_value():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # expected -198 given literally in issue
    assert parabola_directrix(5, 3, 2) == -198


def test_issue_example_kwargs():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # expected -198 given literally in issue
    assert parabola_directrix(a=5, b=3, c=2) == -198


def test_issue_example_reordered_kwargs():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # expected -198 given literally in issue
    assert parabola_directrix(c=2, a=5, b=3) == -198


def test_issue_example_stable():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # expected -198 given literally in issue; check both calls equal -198
    assert parabola_directrix(5, 3, 2) == parabola_directrix(5, 3, 2) == -198


def test_issue_example_plus_198():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # -198 + 198 = 0
    assert parabola_directrix(5, 3, 2) + 198 == 0


def test_issue_example_times_two():
    """Example asserts parabola_directrix(5,3,2)==-198."""
    # -198 * 2 = -396
    assert parabola_directrix(5, 3, 2) * 2 == -396


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface defines parabola_directrix(a, b, c) in solution."""
    # expected True literal for callable check
    assert callable(parabola_directrix) is True


def test_contract_exposed():
    """Public interface defines parabola_directrix(a, b, c) in solution."""
    # expected True literal for hasattr check
    assert hasattr(solution, "parabola_directrix") is True


def test_contract_three_params():
    """Public interface defines parabola_directrix(a, b, c) in solution."""
    # 3 params: a, b, c
    assert len(inspect.signature(parabola_directrix).parameters) == 3


def test_contract_param_names():
    """Public interface defines parabola_directrix(a, b, c) in solution."""
    # expected ["a", "b", "c"] from public interface
    assert list(inspect.signature(parabola_directrix).parameters) == ["a", "b", "c"]
